scene_target: Artie strikes the 'indestructible' lock, triggering a massive critical hit that shatters it, allowing him to loot the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion.
goal: Artie seeks gear to survive his 1 HP fragility and exploits a quest loophole.
conflict: The lock is supposed to be unbreakable without a specific skill, and Artie only has a rusty dagger.
end_condition: Artie steals the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion from a locked starter chest.
transition_in_text: Artie stands before the tutorial chest, Rusty Iron Dagger in hand, ready to test his glitched stats.
